RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was almost certainly not a deciding factor between the two of you. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear misplaced and could harm your professional reputation with the municipality. 

While an all-male panel may reflect institutional diversity blind spots, it does not demonstrate sex discrimination against you. For a director-level position, municipalities frequently weigh public engagement, consensus-building, and political acumen more heavily than technical qualifications or advanced degrees. 

Instead of raising gender bias, send a polite follow-up inquiry regarding your requested feedback, focusing strictly on how you can improve your candidacy and executive interview performance for future roles.
